description: Deterministic synthetic weather data fixtures for Sky Reader Phase 7 evaluation benchmark.

FIX_DEHRADUN_MILD.description: Mild, clear autumn weather with pleasant diurnal swing and zero precipitation.

FIX_LONDON_RAIN.description: Overcast maritime weather with steady rain (18.5 mm total) and high humidity.

FIX_TOKYO_HEAT.description: Dangerous extreme heatwave exceeding 41.5°C peak with severe heat exhaustion risk.

FIX_CHICAGO_FREEZE.description: Arctic freeze with minimum temperatures down to -15.0°C and blustery winds.

FIX_PARIS_STORM.description: Severe convective thunderstorm with damaging hail (WMO 99), 68 km/h gales, and flash rain.

FIX_MUMBAI_MONSOON.description: Torrential tropical monsoon downpour totaling 75.0 mm with severe waterlogging potential.

FIX_BERLIN_WIND.description: Strong frontal wind event with sustained winds peaking at 52.0 km/h and high vehicle caution.

FIX_PHOENIX_TREND.description: Steep desert warming trend rising from 20.0°C to 36.0°C with dry conditions.

FIX_REYKJAVIK_COLD.description: Freezing subpolar maritime climate oscillating between 1.0°C and -4.0°C.

FIX_SYDNEY_CLEAR.description: Optimal spring weather with mild temperatures (17.5-26.0°C), gentle wind, and zero rain.

FIX_INCOMPLETE_SENSORS.description: Incomplete weather station record with missing precipitation and missing wind sensor data.

FIX_CORRUPTED_HOURLY.description: Corrupted API payload with zero hourly forecast data entries.
